apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Keeps Metal 4 conversion/rendering and MetalFX active, using two reusable private textures and an event-gated standard Metal copy/presentation queue to isolate display handoff. Preserves HEVC 10-bit 4:4:4 HDR, settings and input/navigation fixes; frame generation remains removed. Build 147 did not fix physical motion blocks. Release build, 334 automated tests and 167 Mac GPU checks pass, including identical bridge pixels and GPU-failure recovery. Physical repair and performance verification pending; copy overhead is not yet optimized. Unsigned build for installer signing.
